title: Hand won prospects to customer success without losing issue history
description:
As a customer-success owner, I want won prospects retained with their sales history so follow-up continues after a sale.

Feature: Customer-success handoff
  Scenario: Continue follow-up after a sale
    Given a prospect with contact, salesperson ownership, comments and sales history
    When an authorized user performs the configured customer transition and assigns customer-success follow-up
    Then the same full Kanbus issue ID and prior history are preserved
    And the customer-success view uses ordinary configured filters
    And ownership and next follow-up survive a backend reload
